detail.longDescription:
Reviewing #hardware designs shouldn’t mean eyeballing two versions and hoping you spot what changed. That's a recipe for delays and deeper expenses.

We’re building affordable #EDA review that shows actual diffs for schematics and PCBs. Review your hardware, firmware, drivers, and docs all in the same tool, with the same policies and approval flows.

This is in development. If hardware review is a pain point for your team, we’d love to talk to you. 

https://www.reviewboard.org/eda-review/ 

#PCB #selfhosted
